第 134 章 巨灵神守护硬抗破晓（第1页）
中路是整个大阵的核心，也是破晓君王所在的位置。
庄周站在废墟之上，不断催动蝶力，制造幻象干扰破晓君王。但他的灵力已经几乎耗尽，幻象很快便被破晓君王的黑色能量撕碎。
“庄周，你的小把戏已经没用了。”破晓君王冷冷地说道，“今天，我要亲手杀了你，为我的六绝猎杀大阵报仇！”
说完，破晓君王猛地一挥手，一道黑色的能量光束朝着庄周劈去。
就在这千钧一发之际，一个巨大的身影猛地冲了过来，挡在了庄周的面前。
黑色的能量光束狠狠击中了那个身影。
原来，巨灵神当时并没有死。神农女拼尽全力，用百草灵力保住了他的性命。虽然他失去了一条手臂，但他的意志却更加坚定。
“庄周大人，我没事。”巨灵神缓缓转过身，对着庄周露出了一个憨厚的笑容。他的胸前被能量光束击中，血肉模糊，深可见骨。但他的眼神，却依旧无比坚定。
“巨灵神，你怎么来了？你应该好好养伤的。”庄周说道，眼中充满了愧疚。
“我是龙国的战士，守护大家是我的责任。”巨灵神说道，“只要我还活着，就绝不会让破晓君王伤害你。”
说完，巨灵神猛地转过身，面对着天空中的破晓君王。他用仅存的一只手臂，凝聚出了一只巨大的岩石手臂。
“破晓君王，你的对手是我！”巨灵神怒吼一声，朝着破晓君王冲了过去。
“不自量力。”破晓君王冷哼一声，随手一挥，又是一道黑色的能量光束射向巨灵神。
巨灵神不闪不避，用岩石手臂挡住了能量光束。
但巨灵神丝毫没有退缩，继续朝着破晓君王冲去。
“找死！”破晓君王眼中闪过一丝杀意，连续射出数道能量光束。
能量光束接连击中巨灵神的身体，在他的身上留下了一个个恐怖的血洞。
巨灵神的身体摇摇欲坠，但他依旧没有倒下。他死死地盯着破晓君王，一步一步地向前走去。
“我……绝不会让你……伤害大家……”
巨灵神的声音断断续续，每说一个字，都会吐出一大口鲜血。
破晓君王看着巨灵神，眼中闪过一丝惊讶。他没有想到，这个看似笨拙的巨人，竟然有如此顽强的意志。
“既然你这么想死，那我就成全你！”
破晓君王猛地将右手向下一挥，一道比之前任何一次都要强大的黑色能量光束，朝着巨灵神劈去。
庄周大喊道，想要冲过去帮忙，却被一股强大的威压死死地压在地上，动弹不得。
巨灵神抬起头，看着迎面而来的能量光束，脸上没有丝毫恐惧。他用尽最后一丝力气，将身体挡在了庄周的面前。
巨灵神的身体猛地一颤，然后缓缓倒了下去。
但他的眼睛，依旧圆睁着，死死地盯着天空中的破晓君王。

Chapter 134 The guardian of the giant spirit god resists the dawn (page 1)
The middle lane is the core of the entire formation, and it is also where the King of Dawn is located.
Zhuang Zhou stood on the ruins, constantly activating the butterfly power, creating illusions to disturb the King of Dawn. But his spiritual power was almost exhausted, and the illusion was soon torn apart by the black energy of the King of Dawn.
"Zhuang Zhou, your little tricks are useless." King Daybreak said coldly, "Today, I will kill you with my own hands to avenge my Six Ultimate Hunting Formation!"
After saying that, the King of Dawn waved his hand suddenly, and a black energy beam struck towards Zhuang Zhou.
At this critical moment, a huge figure rushed over and stood in front of Zhuang Zhou.
The black energy beam hit the figure hard.
It turned out that the giant spirit god was not dead at that time. Shen Nong Nu tried her best to save his life with the spiritual power of Baicao. Although he lost an arm, his will became stronger.
"Lord Zhuang Zhou, I'm fine." The Giant Spirit God slowly turned around and showed an honest smile to Zhuang Zhou. His chest was hit by an energy beam, his flesh and blood were blurred, and his bones were clearly visible. But his eyes were still extremely determined.
"Giant Spirit God, why are you here? You should take good care of your injuries." Zhuang Zhou said, his eyes full of guilt.
"I am a warrior of the Dragon Kingdom, and it is my responsibility to protect everyone." The Giant Spirit God said, "As long as I am alive, I will never let the King of Dawn harm you."
After saying that, the Giant Spirit God suddenly turned around and faced the King of Dawn in the sky. He used his only remaining arm to condense a huge rock arm.
"King of Dawn, your opponent is me!" The Giant Spirit God roared and rushed towards King of Dawn.
"You don't overestimate your capabilities." King Dawn snorted coldly, and with a wave of his hand, another black energy beam shot towards the Giant Spirit God.
The Djinn God did not dodge and blocked the energy beam with its rock arm.
But the Giant Spirit God did not flinch at all and continued to rush towards the King of Dawn.
"Seeking death!" A trace of murderous intent flashed in the eyes of King Breaking Dawn, and he shot several energy beams in succession.
The energy beams hit the giant spirit god's body one after another, leaving horrific blood holes on his body.
The giant spirit god's body was shaky, but he still did not fall. He stared at the King of Dawn and walked forward step by step.
"I...will never let you...hurt everyone..."
The voice of the giant spirit god was intermittent, and every time he said a word, he would spit out a large mouthful of blood.
The Dawn King looked at the Giant Spirit God with a trace of surprise in his eyes. He didn't expect that this seemingly clumsy giant would have such a strong will.
"Since you want to die so much, then I will make it happen for you!"
The Dawn King suddenly waved his right hand down, and a black energy beam more powerful than any before struck towards the Giant Spirit God.
Zhuang Zhou shouted and wanted to rush over to help, but he was pinned to the ground by a strong force and could not move.
The Giant Spirit God raised his head and looked at the oncoming energy beam, without any fear on his face. He used his last bit of strength to block his body in front of Zhuang Zhou.
The giant spirit god's body trembled suddenly, and then slowly fell down.
But his eyes were still wide open, staring at the King of Dawn in the sky.
